title: Chicago Water Sport Rentals
specs: All drivers/operators must be 21 years of age or older with a government issued I.D.
Coast Guard (USCG) approved personal flotation device (PFD/life jacket) and a safety whistle.
Insurance requires that all operators must be able to understand and speak English fluently so to understand safety & operation instructions.
Tandem Riders: $10 extra rider fee applies For safety, if any rider wears a XXL PFD/life jacket then that person must ride solo.
Operators and riders who each wear a XL PFD/life jacket must also ride solo or with a smaller rider.
A person any age can be a rider on a jet ski as long as they are accompanied by their parent or legal guardian.
